column1: The following are example semi-random surgery times for 5 days. Each day, there are 10 Operation
Rooms (OR), where there is not always an operation scheduled. The times are in hours, with
each day starting at 7:00 and ending at 20:00. The times are semi-random, as they are based
on OR surgery times from 5 different days, but are randomly perturbed. An OperationX is
defined by its start and end time [start_time_hours, end_time_hours].
